svg.title: Black Panel
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Christie’s official photograph recovered through the .com.cn image host; black scalene triangular canvas, EK741. Photo wall and mounting shadow omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.christies.com/en/lot/lot-2056202; record christies-2056202; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
